manifest.role: Fixed-matrix development replay of already observed candidates; no fresh held-out or Agent evaluation

profiles.A_augmented_control: Previously recorded actual product Top-4, with automatic exact prefix and page deduplication.
profiles.B_dense_page_no_exact: Previously recorded plain Dense Top-4: remove only the exact prefix.
profiles.C_dense_passage_no_exact: First four raw Dense passages, no page deduplication or exact prefix.
profiles.D_bm25_passage_no_exact: First four raw BM25 passages, no page deduplication or exact prefix.
profiles.E_rrf_passage_no_exact: Fixed RRF k=60 on raw Top-20 passages per source, merge by record ID, return four.
profiles.F_rrf_page_same_pool: Same raw Top-20 per source as E, but collapse to one passage per page and apply existing page-level RRF. Isolates early page collapse; not the production fetch-20-pages profile.

manifest.product_filter: No new filter; A retains its historical exact-branch product input.
